# Azure Arc – Connected Machine Agent Version Compliance
**What this workbook answers:** ① Are my Azure Arc agents on a **supported version**? ② Is **automatic agent upgrade** enabled and working? ③ **What must be fixed**, and on which servers?

**How to use it:** choose subscriptions and filters above → **1 Overview** and **2 Distribution** for the big picture → **3 Advisor** for blockers (expired / disconnected) → **4 Server inventory** for the server list → **5 Automatic upgrade** and **6 Manual upgrade paths** to fix → **7 Policy** to enforce at scale → **8 Extensions** as an extra check. Every table can be filtered and exported to Excel. No version list is maintained in this workbook – the reference is read live from Azure.

# Azure Arc – Conformidade de versão do Connected Machine Agent
**O que este workbook responde:** ① Meus agents Azure Arc estão numa **versão suportada**? ② O **upgrade automático do agent** está habilitado e funcionando? ③ **O que precisa ser corrigido** e em quais servidores?

**Como usar:** escolha assinaturas e filtros acima → **1 Visão geral** e **2 Distribuição** para o panorama → **3 Advisor** para bloqueios (expirados / desconectados) → **4 Inventário** para a lista de servidores → **5 Upgrade automático** e **6 Caminhos de upgrade manual** para corrigir → **7 Policy** para aplicar em escala → **8 Extensões** como verificação extra. Todas as tabelas podem ser filtradas e exportadas para Excel. Nenhuma lista de versões é mantida no workbook – a referência é lida do Azure em tempo real.

parameters.name: OsFilter
parameters.label: OS
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| summarize by value = tolower(tostring(properties.osType))
| where isnotempty(value)
| order by value asc

parameters.name: StatusFilter
parameters.label: Connection Status
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| summarize by value = tostring(properties.status)
| order by value asc

parameters.name: ApiVersion
parameters.label: HybridCompute API version
parameters.description: api-version used to read the official agent catalog (Agent Version - List).

parameters.name: SupportWindow
parameters.label: Support window (releases)
parameters.description: Number of most recent official releases treated as 'released within the last year'. The catalog API exposes no release dates, so the window is expressed in releases (Arc ships ~monthly).

parameters.name: AutoUpgradeTolerance
parameters.label: Auto-upgrade tolerance (releases)
parameters.description: Docs: with automatic upgrade the agent is kept within one version of the latest release.

parameters.name: IncludeFleetMax
parameters.label: Use fleet max as latest source
parameters.description: Also consider the highest agent version running in the fleet when determining 'latest' (not an official source).

parameters.name: LatestOverride
parameters.label: Latest override (optional)
parameters.description: Optional: type the latest version from the release notes (e.g. 1.68) to force it as reference.

parameters.name: ExtApiVersion
parameters.label: Extension metadata API version
parameters.description: api-version for Extension Metadata V2 - List (versions published by Azure per region/publisher/type).

parameters.name: MinAutoUpgradeVersion
parameters.label: Min version for auto-upgrade
parameters.description: Docs: automatic agent upgrade is available starting with agent 1.57.

parameters.name: SecurityFloorVersion
parameters.label: Security floor (min agent version)
parameters.description: Agents below this version are flagged regardless of the support window. Default 1.61: known local elevation-of-privilege CVEs fixed in later agents (CVE-2025-49692, CVE-2025-26627, CVE-2025-55316, CVE-2026-26117) – same criterion as Arc Posture Review. Leave empty to disable.

parameters.name: FleetMinWindows
parameters.label: Oldest agent in fleet – Windows
parameters.description: Oldest Windows agent version found (drives the download list).
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| where tolower(tostring(properties.osType)) == 'windows'
| extend av = tostring(properties.agentVersion)
| where isnotempty(av)
| extend r = toint(split(av, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(av, '.')[1])
| summarize r = min(r)
| project v = iff(isnull(r), 'none', strcat(tostring(r / 1000), '.', tostring(r % 1000)))

parameters.name: FleetMinLinux
parameters.label: Oldest agent in fleet – Linux
parameters.description: Oldest Linux agent version found (drives the download list).
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| where tolower(tostring(properties.osType)) == 'linux'
| extend av = tostring(properties.agentVersion)
| where isnotempty(av)
| extend r = toint(split(av, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(av, '.')[1])
| summarize r = min(r)
| project v = iff(isnull(r), 'none', strcat(tostring(r / 1000), '.', tostring(r % 1000)))

parameters.name: CatAboveWindows
parameters.label: Catalog ≥ fleet min (Windows)
parameters.description: Set only when the catalog API has versions >= oldest Windows agent in the fleet.

parameters.name: CatAboveLinux
parameters.label: Catalog ≥ fleet min (Linux)
parameters.description: Set only when the catalog API has versions >= oldest Linux agent in the fleet.

parameters.name: AnyOsTarget
parameters.label: Auto-upgrade target (any OS)
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| extend dv = tostring(properties.agentUpgrade.desiredVersion), lv = tostring(properties.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptDesiredVersion)
| extend dr = iff(isempty(dv), int(null), toint(split(dv, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(dv, '.')[1])), lr = iff(isempty(lv), int(null), toint(split(lv, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(lv, '.')[1]))
| summarize t = max(max_of(coalesce(dr, -1), coalesce(lr, -1)))
| project v = iff(isnull(t) or t < 0, 'none', strcat(tostring(t / 1000), '.', tostring(t % 1000)))

parameters.name: LatestSummary
parameters.label: Latest summary
parameters.query:
resources
| where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
| extend p = properties
| extend osType = tolower(tostring(p.osType)), agentVersion = tostring(p.agentVersion), status = tostring(p.status)
| extend agentRank = iff(isempty(agentVersion), int(null), toint(split(agentVersion, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(agentVersion, '.')[1]))
| extend autoUpgradeEnabled = tobool(p.agentUpgrade.enableAutomaticUpgrade), desiredVersion = tostring(p.agentUpgrade.desiredVersion), lastAttemptStatus = iff(isempty(tostring(p.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptStatus)), '', strcat(toupper(substring(tostring(p.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptStatus), 0, 1)), tolower(substring(tostring(p.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptStatus), 1)))), lastAttemptDesiredVersion = tostring(p.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptDesiredVersion), lastAttemptTimestamp = todatetime(p.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptTimestamp), lastAttemptMessage = tostring(p.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptMessage)
| extend lastStatusChange = todatetime(p.lastStatusChange), osSku = tostring(p.osSku), osName = tostring(p.osName), osVersion = tostring(p.osVersion), machineFqdn = tostring(p.machineFqdn), machineKind = tostring(kind), cloudProvider = tostring(p.detectedProperties.cloudprovider), proxyUrl = tostring(p.agentConfiguration.proxyUrl)
| project id = tolower(id), name, subscriptionId, resourceGroup, location, osType, agentVersion, agentRank, status, autoUpgradeEnabled, desiredVersion, lastAttemptStatus, lastAttemptDesiredVersion, lastAttemptTimestamp, lastAttemptMessage, lastStatusChange, osSku, osName, osVersion, machineFqdn, machineKind, cloudProvider, proxyUrl
| join kind=leftouter (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
    | extend osType = tolower(tostring(properties.osType)), av = tostring(properties.agentVersion), dv = tostring(properties.agentUpgrade.desiredVersion), lv = tostring(properties.agentUpgrade.lastAttemptDesiredVersion)
    | extend ar = iff(isempty(av), int(null), toint(split(av, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(av, '.')[1])), dr = iff(isempty(dv), int(null), toint(split(dv, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(dv, '.')[1])), lr = iff(isempty(lv), int(null), toint(split(lv, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(lv, '.')[1]))
    | summarize fleetMaxRank = max(ar), desiredMaxRank = max(dr), attemptMaxRank = max(lr) by osType
    | extend lst = iff(osType == 'linux', split('{ReleasedLinux}', ','), split('{ReleasedWindows}', ','))
    | mv-expand v = lst to typeof(string) limit 2000
    | extend vRank = iff(isempty(v), int(null), toint(split(v, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(v, '.')[1]))
    | summarize catalogMaxRank = max(vRank), catalogOldestRank = min(vRank), catalogSize = countif(isnotnull(vRank)), catalogSet = make_set(vRank) by osType, fleetMaxRank, desiredMaxRank, attemptMaxRank
    | extend catalogList = strcat(',', strcat_array(catalogSet, ','), ',')
    | project-away catalogSet

| extend targetMaxRank = iff(isnull(desiredMaxRank) or (isnotnull(attemptMaxRank) and attemptMaxRank > desiredMaxRank), attemptMaxRank, desiredMaxRank)
| extend overrideRank = iff(isempty('{LatestOverride}'), int(null), toint(split('{LatestOverride}', '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split('{LatestOverride}', '.')[1]))

| extend autoLatest = max_of(c1, c2, c3, c4)
| extend latestRank = case(isnotnull(overrideRank), overrideRank, autoLatest >= 0, autoLatest, int(null))
| extend latestSource = case(isnotnull(overrideRank), 'Manual override', isnull(latestRank), 'Unavailable', latestRank == c2, 'Azure auto-upgrade target', latestRank == c4, 'Azure auto-upgrade target (other OS)', latestRank == c1, 'Catalog API', 'Fleet maximum')
| extend minAutoRank = toint(split('{MinAutoUpgradeVersion}', '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split('{MinAutoUpgradeVersion}', '.')[1])
| extend desiredRank = iff(isempty(desiredVersion), int(null), toint(split(desiredVersion, '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split(desiredVersion, '.')[1]))
| extend officialLatest = iff(isnull(latestRank), '-', strcat(tostring(latestRank / 1000), '.', tostring(latestRank % 1000)))
| extend agentMajorMinor = iff(isnull(agentRank), 'Unknown', strcat(tostring(agentRank / 1000), '.', tostring(agentRank % 1000)))
| extend inCatalog = isnotnull(agentRank) and catalogList contains strcat(',', tostring(agentRank), ',')
| extend catalogMatch = case(isnull(agentRank), 'No agent version reported', isnull(catalogSize) or catalogSize == 0, 'Catalog API returned nothing', inCatalog, 'Listed in catalog API', agentRank > catalogMaxRank, 'Newer than catalog API', agentRank < catalogOldestRank, 'Older than catalog API', 'Not listed (gap)')
| extend versionsBehind = iff(isnull(agentRank) or isnull(latestRank), int(null), iff(latestRank > agentRank, latestRank - agentRank, 0))
| extend supportStatus = case(isnull(agentRank) or isnull(latestRank), 'Unknown', agentRank >= latestRank, 'Latest', versionsBehind < toint('{SupportWindow}'), 'Supported', 'Out of support')
| extend autoUpgradeLabel = case(autoUpgradeEnabled == true, 'Enabled', autoUpgradeEnabled == false, 'Disabled', 'N/A')
| extend autoUpgradeEligible = isnotnull(agentRank) and agentRank >= minAutoRank
| extend upgradeHealth = case(isnull(agentRank), 'Unknown', autoUpgradeLabel == 'Enabled' and isnotnull(versionsBehind) and versionsBehind <= toint('{AutoUpgradeTolerance}'), 'On track', autoUpgradeLabel == 'Enabled' and lastAttemptStatus =~ 'Failed', 'Failing', autoUpgradeLabel == 'Enabled' and status != 'Connected', 'Blocked (not connected)', autoUpgradeLabel == 'Enabled', 'Lagging', autoUpgradeEligible, 'Disabled (eligible)', isnotnull(agentRank), 'Not eligible (manual upgrade)', 'Unknown')
| extend desiredVsOfficial = case(isnull(desiredRank), '-', isnull(latestRank), 'Latest unavailable', desiredRank >= latestRank, 'Targets latest', 'Targets older than latest')
| extend upgradeStatus = case(isnull(desiredRank), '-', agentRank >= desiredRank, 'Completed', status != 'Connected', 'Pending (offline)', 'Pending')
| extend daysInStatus = datetime_diff('day', now(), lastStatusChange)
| extend dataFreshness = iff(status == 'Connected', 'Live', 'Last reported (stale)')
| extend floorRank = iff(isempty('{SecurityFloorVersion}'), int(null), toint(split('{SecurityFloorVersion}', '.')[0]) * 1000 + toint(split('{SecurityFloorVersion}', '.')[1]))
| extend securityFloor = case(isnull(floorRank), 'Not evaluated', isnull(agentRank), 'Unknown', agentRank < floorRank, 'Below security floor', 'OK')
| where osType in ({OsFilter}) or 'All' in ({OsFilter})
| where status in ({StatusFilter}) or 'All' in ({StatusFilter})
| where supportStatus in ({SupportFilter}) or 'All' in ({SupportFilter})
| where autoUpgradeLabel in ({AutoUpgradeFilter}) or 'All' in ({AutoUpgradeFilter})
| summarize lr = max(latestRank) by osType, latestSource
| extend s = strcat(osType, ' ', iff(isnull(lr), '-', strcat(tostring(lr / 1000), '.', tostring(lr % 1000))), ' (', latestSource, ')')
| summarize v = strcat_array(make_list(s), ' · ')

> 📏 **Reference in use** · latest agent **{LatestSummary}**
> - **Supported** = fewer than **{SupportWindow}** releases behind latest (Microsoft supports agent versions released within the last year). **On track** = auto-upgrade on and ≤ **{AutoUpgradeTolerance}** release behind. · **Security floor** = agent ≥ **{SecurityFloorVersion}** (known elevation-of-privilege CVEs below it).
> - ⚠️ Support status is an **estimate** – confirm dates in the [agent release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes). Auxiliary tool, **not** an official Microsoft compliance report.

> 📏 **Referência em uso** · agent latest **{LatestSummary}**
> - **Suportado** = menos de **{SupportWindow}** releases atrás da latest (a Microsoft suporta versões do agent lançadas no último ano). **Em dia** = upgrade automático ativo e ≤ **{AutoUpgradeTolerance}** release atrás. · **Piso de segurança** = agent ≥ **{SecurityFloorVersion}** (CVEs conhecidos de elevação de privilégio abaixo dele).
> - ⚠️ O status de suporte é uma **estimativa** – confirme as datas nas [release notes do agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes). Ferramenta auxiliar, **não** é relatório oficial de compliance da Microsoft.

##### 📖 Version status
| Status | Meaning → action |
|---|---|
| **Latest** | On latest version → none |
| **Supported** | Behind, inside support window → plan upgrade / enable auto-upgrade |
| **Out of support** | Beyond support window → upgrade now |
| **Unknown** | No version or no reference → check connectivity / *Latest override* |
| **Last reported (stale)** | Server offline, version is last reported → reconnect |
| **LatestSource** | Origin of *latest*: Azure auto-upgrade target, Catalog API, Fleet max or Override |
| **Below security floor** | Agent below the security floor (known CVEs) → upgrade now, even if *Supported* |

##### 🔄 Auto-upgrade status
| Status | Meaning → action |
|---|---|
| **On track** | Enabled, within tolerance → none |
| **Lagging** | Enabled, behind tolerance → check last attempt |
| **Failing** | Last attempt failed → review message, PS execution policy, proxy |
| **Blocked (not connected)** | Enabled but offline → restore connectivity |
| **Disabled (eligible)** | Supported but off → enable (Policy / CLI) |
| **Not eligible (manual upgrade)** | Agent below min version → upgrade manually |

##### 📖 Status de versão
| Status | Significado → ação |
|---|---|
| **Latest** | Na versão mais recente → nenhuma |
| **Supported** | Atrás, dentro da janela de suporte → planejar upgrade / habilitar auto-upgrade |
| **Out of support** | Fora da janela de suporte → atualizar agora |
| **Unknown** | Sem versão ou sem referência → verificar conectividade / *Latest override* |
| **Last reported (stale)** | Servidor offline, versão é a última reportada → reconectar |
| **LatestSource** | Origem da *latest*: alvo do auto-upgrade do Azure, API de catálogo, máximo da frota ou override |
| **Below security floor** | Agent abaixo do piso de segurança (CVEs conhecidos) → atualizar agora, mesmo se *Supported* |

##### 🔄 Status do upgrade automático
| Status | Significado → ação |
|---|---|
| **On track** | Ativo, dentro da tolerância → nenhuma |
| **Lagging** | Ativo, além da tolerância → ver última tentativa |
| **Failing** | Última tentativa falhou → ver mensagem, execution policy do PS, proxy |
| **Blocked (not connected)** | Ativo, mas offline → restabelecer conectividade |
| **Disabled (eligible)** | Suportado, mas desligado → habilitar (Policy / CLI) |
| **Not eligible (manual upgrade)** | Agent abaixo da versão mínima → atualizar manualmente |

| extend Issue = case(IssueCategory == 'Failure', strcat(case(isnotempty(_reason), trim(@'[\s,;:]+', _reason), isnotempty(_fallback), _fallback, 'No detail in status message'), iff(isnotempty(_exit), strcat(' [', _exit, ']'), '')),
                    IssueCategory == 'Health warning', strcat_array(_payload.healthIssues, '; '),
                    IssueCategory == 'OK', '-',
                    _state)
| extend Issue = replace_regex(Issue, @'[0-9a-fA-F]{8}-?[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-?[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-?[0-9a-fA-F]{4}-?[0-9a-fA-F]{12}|\b[0-9a-fA-F]{20,}\b', '*')
| extend vr = (coalesce(tolong(split(ver, '.')[0]), 0) * 1000000000000000 + coalesce(tolong(split(ver, '.')[1]), 0) * 10000000000 + coalesce(tolong(split(ver, '.')[2]), 0) * 100000 + coalesce(tolong(split(ver, '.')[3]), 0)), avail = array_concat(split('{ExtAvailable}', ','), iff('{ExtAvailableJson}' startswith '[', todynamic('{ExtAvailableJson}'), pack_array('{ExtAvailableJson}')))
| extend selRank = iff('{ExtTargetVersion}' == 'latest' or isempty('{ExtTargetVersion}'), long(null), (coalesce(tolong(split('{ExtTargetVersion}', '.')[0]), 0) * 1000000000000000 + coalesce(tolong(split('{ExtTargetVersion}', '.')[1]), 0) * 10000000000 + coalesce(tolong(split('{ExtTargetVersion}', '.')[2]), 0) * 100000 + coalesce(tolong(split('{ExtTargetVersion}', '.')[3]), 0)))
| mv-expand a = avail to typeof(string) limit 2000
| extend ar = iff(isempty(a), long(null), (coalesce(tolong(split(a, '.')[0]), 0) * 1000000000000000 + coalesce(tolong(split(a, '.')[1]), 0) * 10000000000 + coalesce(tolong(split(a, '.')[2]), 0) * 100000 + coalesce(tolong(split(a, '.')[3]), 0)))
| summarize by machineId, ExtensionName = name, ver, vr, AutoUpgrade, State, StatusMessage, IssueCategory, Issue, selRank, ar
| summarize availMax = max(ar), availCount = countif(isnotnull(ar)), newer = countif(ar > vr), newerToSel = countif(ar > vr and ar <= selRank), listed = countif(ar == vr), selListed = countif(ar == selRank) by selRank, machineId, ExtensionName, ver, vr, AutoUpgrade, State, StatusMessage, IssueCategory, Issue
| join kind=inner (
    resources
    | where type =~ 'microsoft.hybridcompute/machines'
    | extend _os = tolower(tostring(properties.osType)), _st = tostring(properties.status), _au = case(tobool(properties.agentUpgrade.enableAutomaticUpgrade) == true, 'Enabled', tobool(properties.agentUpgrade.enableAutomaticUpgrade) == false, 'Disabled', 'N/A')
    | where _os in ({OsFilter}) or 'All' in ({OsFilter})
    | where _st in ({StatusFilter}) or 'All' in ({StatusFilter})
    | where _au in ({AutoUpgradeFilter}) or 'All' in ({AutoUpgradeFilter})
    | project machineId = tolower(id), Server = name, ResourceGroup = resourceGroup, ConnectionStatus = _st
) on machineId
| extend LatestPublished = iff(isnull(availMax), '-', strcat(tostring(availMax / 1000000000000000), '.', tostring((availMax / 10000000000) % 100000), '.', tostring((availMax / 100000) % 100000), '.', tostring(availMax % 100000)))
| extend useSel = selListed > 0
| extend tr = iff(useSel, selRank, availMax)
| extend Target = iff(useSel, iff(isnull(selRank), '-', strcat(tostring(selRank / 1000000000000000), '.', tostring((selRank / 10000000000) % 100000), '.', tostring((selRank / 100000) % 100000), '.', tostring(selRank % 100000))), strcat(iff(isnull(availMax), '-', strcat(tostring(availMax / 1000000000000000), '.', tostring((availMax / 10000000000) % 100000), '.', tostring((availMax / 100000) % 100000), '.', tostring(availMax % 100000))), ' (latest)'))
| extend BehindTarget = iff(useSel, newerToSel, newer)
| extend VersionStatus = case(availCount == 0, 'Unknown (no versions returned)', vr >= availMax, 'Latest', vr >= tr, 'At or above target', listed == 0, 'No longer offered by Azure', 'Below target')
| extend UpgradeOutlook = case(VersionStatus == 'Latest', 'Up to date', VersionStatus == 'At or above target', 'Meets target', AutoUpgrade == 'Enabled' and ConnectionStatus == 'Connected', 'Auto-upgrade will move it', AutoUpgrade == 'Enabled', 'Auto-upgrade blocked (not connected)', 'Manual upgrade or enable auto-upgrade')
| extend p = case(IssueCategory == 'Failure', 0, VersionStatus == 'No longer offered by Azure', 1, IssueCategory == 'Health warning', 2, VersionStatus == 'Below target', 3, VersionStatus startswith 'Unknown', 4, 5)
| order by p asc, Server asc
| project Server, ResourceGroup, ConnectionStatus, InstalledVersion = ver, Target, BehindTarget, VersionStatus, LatestPublished, BehindLatest = newer, AutoUpgrade, UpgradeOutlook, ProvisioningState = State, IssueCategory, Issue, StatusMessage, ResourceId = machineId

> ℹ️ **How "latest" and status are computed (no hard-coded versions)**
> - **Latest (per OS)** = highest of: (1) the **auto-upgrade target set by Azure** on any machine (`agentUpgrade.desiredVersion` / `lastAttemptDesiredVersion`), (2) the **Hybrid Compute agent catalog API**, (3) optionally the fleet maximum, or (4) a manual override. Column *LatestSource* shows which one won.
> - The catalog API returns a **paged** list whose content varies between calls and, in tests, did not include the newest release – it is therefore cross-checked, not used alone.
> - **Versions behind** = minor-version distance to latest. Arc releases are numbered sequentially and shipped monthly ([release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes)).
> - **Supported** = fewer than *{SupportWindow}* releases behind. Policy: only agent versions released within the last year are supported. Confirm exact dates in the release notes.
> - **Auto-upgrade "On track"** = enabled and ≤ *{AutoUpgradeTolerance}* release(s) behind latest ([manage agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/manage-agent)).
> - For **Disconnected/Expired** servers the agent version is the **last reported** value.
>
> ⚠️ *Disclaimer*: auxiliary tool provided as-is; it does not replace official Microsoft compliance reporting.
> - **Security floor** (default 1.61, Edit mode): agents below it are flagged *Below security floor* independently of the support window – known local elevation-of-privilege CVEs (CVE-2025-49692, CVE-2025-26627, CVE-2025-55316, CVE-2026-26117), same criterion as *Arc Posture Review*.

> ℹ️ **Como a "latest" e os status são calculados (sem versões fixas no código)**
> - **Latest (por SO)** = maior valor entre: (1) o **alvo do upgrade automático definido pelo Azure** nas máquinas (`desiredVersion` / `lastAttemptDesiredVersion`), (2) a **API de catálogo do Hybrid Compute**, (3) opcionalmente o máximo da frota, ou (4) um override manual. A coluna *LatestSource* mostra qual prevaleceu.
> - A API de catálogo é **paginada**, seu conteúdo varia entre chamadas e, nos testes, não trouxe a release mais recente – por isso é usada só como comparação.
> - **Versões atrás** = distância de versão menor até a latest. As releases do Arc são numeradas em sequência e mensais ([release notes](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/agent-release-notes)).
> - **Supported** = menos de *{SupportWindow}* releases atrás. Política: só versões do agent lançadas no último ano são suportadas. Confirme as datas nas release notes.
> - **Upgrade automático "On track"** = ativo e ≤ *{AutoUpgradeTolerance}* release atrás da latest ([gerenciar o agent](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/azure-arc/servers/manage-agent)).
> - Para servidores **Disconnected/Expired**, a versão do agent é o **último valor reportado**.
> - **Piso de segurança** (padrão 1.61, modo Edit): agents abaixo dele são marcados *Below security floor* independentemente da janela de suporte – CVEs conhecidos de elevação de privilégio local (CVE-2025-49692, CVE-2025-26627, CVE-2025-55316, CVE-2026-26117), mesmo critério do *Arc Posture Review*.
